segments.speechObservation: Female narration asks the iOS26 and 750/985 joke questions, then names Quark Deep Search.
segments.nonSpeechObservation: A light produced background-music bed is audible beneath the narration; brief early pauses do not supply independent propositional content.
segments.decisionImpact: No non-speech cue changes the meaning of the opening questions or product reveal.

segments.speechObservation: Narration contrasts mechanical keyword search with thinking first and introduces the usage demonstration.
segments.nonSpeechObservation: The light background bed continues under speech; no separate audible instruction or disclaimer is present.
segments.decisionImpact: The problem/cause/method claims are carried by speech, not by the background bed.

segments.speechObservation: Narration gives the Deep Search entry step, introduces the HTML-to-PPT question, and says the system plans search directions.
segments.nonSpeechObservation: Background music remains subordinate to clear narration; no audible evidence establishes an unshown click, network request, or continuous backend run.
segments.decisionImpact: Operational meaning remains in narration and visible UI.

segments.speechObservation: Narration says the system searches authoritative channels, describes simple tools and developer code, and introduces information authority.
segments.nonSpeechObservation: The produced bed continues; no independent sound verifies source authority, code execution, or answer reliability.
segments.decisionImpact: Reliability and authority remain author claims.

segments.speechObservation: Narration moves from strict information control to the cat-vomiting example and then introduces image editing.
segments.nonSpeechObservation: Background music remains secondary; no audible citation, veterinary qualification, safety disclaimer, or rights notice is added.
segments.decisionImpact: The source-count, medical-result, and image-edit transitions are carried by speech and visuals.

segments.speechObservation: Narration says the picture was edited from one sentence, calls the product an AI-search ceiling with intelligence and search judgment, says it is free, and gives the CTA.
segments.nonSpeechObservation: The produced bed continues through the close; no audible condition qualifies free access, privacy, copyright, latency, or performance.
segments.decisionImpact: The final evaluation and CTA are spoken author claims.
